watch.summary: The streamer energetically reacts to the high-stakes final round of a professional Valorant match between 100 Thieves and Lev.

beats.what: Streamer sets up the match context as the final round begins.
Action erupts in footage with a Bucky kill, sparking hype.
Streamer reacts in shock and laughter at the chaotic engagements.
100 Thieves secures crucial kills to take full control.
100T gets the final kill, closing out the match.
Streamer raises his arms and celebrates the victory.
